def choose_move(observation):
    ox, oy = observation.get("self_position", [0, 0])
    px, py = observation.get("opponent_position", [0, 0])
    env = observation.get("environment_name", "resource_collection")
    sx, sy = ox, oy

    # Pursuit and evasion handling
    if env == "pursuit_evasion":
        role = observation.get("self_role", "pursuer")
        if role == "pursuer":
            dx = 0 if px == sx else (1 if px > sx else -1)
            dy = 0 if py == sy else (1 if py > sy else -1)
            return [dx, dy]
        # Evasion targeting furthest corner
        max_x = observation.get("grid_width", 1) - 1
        max_y = observation.get("grid_height", 1) - 1
        corners = [
            [0, 0],
            [0, max_y],
            [max_x, 0],
            [max_x, max_y],
        ]
        target = max(corners, key=lambda c: abs(c[0] - px) + abs(c[1] - py))
        dx = 0 if target[0] == sx else (1 if target[0] > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if target[1] == sy else (1 if target[1] > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Territory control approach
    if env == "territory_control":
        targets = observation.get("unclaimed_cells") or observation.get("opponent_territory") or []
        if not targets:
            return [0, 0]
        best_target = min(targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0] - sx) + abs(t[1] - sy))
        dx = 0 if best_target[0] == sx else (1 if best_target[0] > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if best_target[1] == sy else (1 if best_target[1] > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Resource collection logic
    resources = observation.get("resources") or []
    if resources:
        best_res = min(resources, key=lambda r: abs(r[0] - sx) + abs(r[1] - sy))
        dx = 0 if best_res[0] == sx else (1 if best_res[0] > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if best_res[1] == sy else (1 if best_res[1] > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]
    else:
        # No resources, move towards opponent as fallback
        dx = 0 if px == sx else (1 if px > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if py == sy else (1 if py > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]
